statements.explanation: Vaccines help protect us from serious diseases by teaching our immune system how to fight them.

statements.statement: Babies need vaccines to help protect them from serious diseases.
statements.explanation: Vaccines help protect babies from several serious and potentially life-threatening diseases.

statements.statement: A healthy-looking baby does not need vaccines.
statements.explanation: Even healthy babies need vaccines because they can still be exposed to vaccine-preventable diseases.

statements.statement: Vaccination can help protect other people in the community.
statements.explanation: Vaccination can reduce the spread of certain vaccine-preventable diseases and help protect people in the community.

statements.statement: It is okay to skip a baby's recommended vaccines if the baby looks healthy.
statements.explanation: Vaccines are recommended according to a schedule to provide babies with protection at the appropriate time.
